name: PUR_NEW_SCIENTIFIC_DECISION_AGENT_V3
purpose: Multi-stage, evidence-firewalled, falsification-aware scientific decision Agent for PUR formulation selection.

stages.role: define failure mode, evidence plan, abstention triggers and counterfactual checks
execute only planner-requested read-only scientific actions behind the evidence firewall
build candidate scorecards, Pareto front and transparent robustness scenarios without held-out outcomes
rank a shortlist from the allowed evidence
attempt to falsify the provisional top candidate and audit leakage/scientific boundaries
resolve proposer-versus-skeptic evidence and freeze a recommendation or abstain

architecture_principles: result data are structurally removed before any blind LLM payload is assembled
planning and evidence acquisition occur before candidate selection
deterministic scientific calculations are separated from language-model judgment
candidate choice is stress-tested across transparent ordinal priorities rather than one hidden scalar score
a dedicated skeptic must try to falsify the provisional recommendation
the final judge may choose a performance candidate, robustness probe, uncertainty probe, or abstain
only concise auditable rationales and tool outputs are stored; hidden chain-of-thought is not required
claim_boundary: V3 is an improved present-day implementation of the scientific decision architecture. It must not be described as the exact historical code that generated the earlier validation formulation unless matching archived runtime provenance is recovered.
